settings.title: DESIGN YOUR GYM WITH A CONCEPTUAL LAYOUT
settings.description: Use the Room Planner to explore an early equipment layout, or request a custom gym plan and quote directly from our team. You do not need to complete the planner before requesting help.
settings.primary_button_text: Get a Custom Gym Plan & Quote
settings.disclaimer: The planner creates a conceptual layout. It does not confirm fit, operating clearances, availability, pricing, or delivery and installation scope. Equipment, pricing and service scope are confirmed separately in your written quote. Final site dimensions, required clearances and any necessary professional approvals must be verified.

settings.title: Explore in 2D and 3D
settings.text: Drag equipment onto your floor plan to compare conceptual arrangements before requesting a Sales-reviewed equipment recommendation and quote.

settings.title: Use your room facts
settings.text: Room length, width, ceiling height, doors, fixed obstructions and training goals help make the concept more useful.

settings.title: Confirm with our team
settings.text: For a quote, share your delivery ZIP, budget, timeline and installation needs. Equipment, pricing, availability and service scope are confirmed separately in writing. Final site dimensions, required clearances and any necessary professional approvals must be verified.
For a full commercial project, see our buildout process and quote flow, or browse ready-made gym packages for common room sizes.
